plan.earlySupporterThanks: Early Supporter, thank you for being here first
plan.proThanks: You're all set. Thanks for supporting the project
plan.ratePro: A rating helps other people find PrivacyNotes.
plan.rateFreeBody: A rating is the best way to say thanks, and it helps other people find us.

restore.heading: Restore purchases
restore.body: Bought Pro or storage through the store and it isn't showing? Restore fetches your purchases from your store account and unlocks them again - after a reinstall or on a new device.
restore.restored: Purchases restored. Everything you own is unlocked again.
restore.none: No purchases found for this store account.
restore.notApplied: A purchase was found, but it belongs to a different account. Sign in with the recovery phrase you were using when you bought it.
restore.error: Could not reach the store. Please try again in a moment.

storage.addonFileSizePerk: Bonus: any add-on lifts your file size limit from 50 MB to 100 MB.
storage.upgradeCharge: You're charged {{amount}} today for the rest of your current year. After that it renews at {{price}}/year.
storage.upgradeChargeUntil: You're charged {{amount}} today for the rest of your current year, until {{date}}. After that it renews at {{price}}/year.
storage.upgradeChargeApple: You're charged {{price}} today. Apple refunds the unused part of your current year automatically, and your new year starts now.
storage.upgradeAmountFailed: The amount due today couldn't be loaded.
storage.upgradeAmountChanged: The amount due today changed or couldn't be checked, so you have not been charged. Choose the package again to see the new amount.
storage.cancelScheduled: Storage will be cancelled at the end of your billing period.
storage.cancelConfirm: Cancel your storage add-on? Your extra space stays until the end of the period you already paid for.
storage.legalNote: Storage add-ons are yearly subscriptions and renew automatically until cancelled. Storage costs us every month, so it is the only recurring price. Pro itself stays a one-time payment.
storage.stepProBody: 500 MB of storage, ten times the room you have now, and 50 MB per file. One payment, nothing renews.
storage.stepAddonBody: On Pro, add 1, 2 or 5 GB right here, from {{price}} a year, up to {{total}} GB in total, with files up to 100 MB. Storage is yearly because we pay for it every month it holds your data. Pro stays a one-time payment, for life.

images.spaceSaverDesc: Resized to fit {{px}} pixels and saved as JPEG at {{quality}}% quality. A small loss of detail for a fraction of the space.
images.removeLocationDesc: The place an image was taken is removed before it is saved, everywhere in the app.
images.contactDesc: Fit inside {{px}} pixels, the largest size the app draws them. Turned off, they follow the space saver settings.
images.applyNote: New images only. Images you already saved are not changed, and files that are not images are never touched.

devices.heading: Registered devices
devices.empty: No registered devices. Sync probably hasn't completed.
devices.updateHint: This version can no longer sync. Update the app on this device.

sync.verifyInSyncPendingBlobs_one: Your notes match the server. {{count}} file is still uploading.
sync.verifyInSyncPendingBlobs_other: Your notes match the server. {{count}} files are still uploading.
sync.verifyInSyncBlockedBlobs_one: Your notes match the server. {{count}} file doesn't fit in your storage.
sync.verifyInSyncBlockedBlobs_other: Your notes match the server. {{count}} files don't fit in your storage.
sync.verifyBusy: Another device is syncing right now, so this check can't give a clean answer. Try again in a moment.
sync.verifyFailed: Couldn't reach the server to check. Try again when you're back online.
sync.verifyDiverged: This device is out of step with the server:
sync.verifyMissing_one: {{count}} item on the server is missing here
sync.verifyMissing_other: {{count}} items on the server are missing here
sync.verifyStale_one: {{count}} item here is older than the server's copy
sync.verifyStale_other: {{count}} items here are older than the server's copy
sync.verifyPendingDelete_one: {{count}} item was deleted elsewhere and is still here
sync.verifyPendingDelete_other: {{count}} items were deleted elsewhere and are still here
sync.verifyNeverPushed_one: {{count}} item here has never reached the server
sync.verifyNeverPushed_other: {{count}} items here have never reached the server
sync.verifyRepairQueued: The next sync will re-read your whole vault. Nothing waiting to upload will be lost.

revoke.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
revoke.bodySelf: This will reset your device registration. Your session stays active. The device re-registers itself immediately.
revoke.bodyOther: This device is signed out the next time it syncs.
revoke.bodyRemoveAll_other: This removes all {{count}} installs in the slot.
revoke.bodyInstall: This install is signed out the next time it syncs.
revoke.bodyInstallOthers_one: The other install in this slot stays.
revoke.bodyInstallOthers_other: The other {{count}} installs in this slot stay.
revoke.freeNote: The slot is freed immediately - you can add a replacement device right away. The removed device stays visible under “Recently removed” for 72 hours.
revoke.freeNoteKept: The slot stays in use while other installs remain in it.

appearance.modeDesc: Auto follows your system and switches between your light and your dark theme.
appearance.lightThemesDesc: Used in light mode, and by Auto when your system is light.
appearance.darkThemesDesc: Used in dark mode, and by Auto when your system is dark.
appearance.peekLight: Showing your light theme for now. Auto follows your system again when you close Settings.
appearance.peekDark: Showing your dark theme for now. Auto follows your system again when you close Settings.
appearance.openInTabsTitle: Show the open item in a tab
appearance.openInTabsDesc: The tab follows what you open next, like in a browser. Pin a tab to keep it. Off closes the tabs that are not pinned, and only "Open in tab" makes a new one. Tabs do not show on phones.
appearance.editorDesc: How notes render while you write.
appearance.copyFormatDesc: What other apps get when you copy from a note. This device only.
appearance.pasteFormatDesc: What a paste from another app keeps. This device only.
appearance.faviconsDesc: Site logos next to links and vault logins.
appearance.faviconsProxy: Loads through our proxy. This device only.
appearance.invisiblesDesc: Show spaces, line breaks and paragraph marks while you write.
appearance.sidebarDesc: Which views appear in the sidebar, and which items the All list holds.
appearance.appZoomDesc: Size of the whole window. This device only.
appearance.textSizeDesc: Size of your writing. This device only.
appearance.contentWidthDesc: How wide a note runs on screen. This device only.
appearance.noteColorsDesc: How a note shows the color of its folder or tag: the whole note, only its icon, or not at all.
appearance.taskConfettiDesc: A little confetti flies from a checkbox when you check it.
appearance.sinkCheckedDesc: A checked item moves below the unchecked items in its list.
appearance.defaultAppsTextHint: .txt and README files you double-click open here.
appearance.defaultAppsTextFinderSteps: To change it, choose Get Info on a .txt file in Finder, pick PrivacyNotes under Open with, and click Change All.
appearance.defaultAppsOwnerOtherUnnamed: They open with another app now.
appearance.defaultAppsOwnerNone: They have no default app yet.
appearance.spacesDesc: Split your library into Personal and Work and show one at a time.
appearance.lineSpacingDesc: Space between lines and paragraphs while you write.
appearance.spellCheckDesc: PrivacyNotes has no spell checker. Your device adds the red underlines and picks their language. Turn them off if it is not the one you write in. This device only.

custom.logoHelp: The logo and “Privacy” take the theme's accent, or keep their original colors.
custom.deleteBody: The theme goes from all your devices. Copy its code first if you want to keep it.
custom.pasteInvalid: This is not a theme code.
custom.pasteLight: {{name}}, a light theme. It shows now; Save keeps it.
custom.pasteDark: {{name}}, a dark theme. It shows now; Save keeps it.
custom.pasteHard: Some colors in this theme are hard to read. Open it in the builder to fix them.
custom.modeHint: Light or dark follows the background.
custom.previewHint: The app behind this panel shows your theme.
custom.name: Name
custom.suggestTitle: Fill the rest from your accent
custom.websiteDesc: Every theme and the latest votes. The app gets new themes with each update.
custom.themeLimit: You have {{max}} themes. Delete one to save another.
custom.creditInvalid: A GitHub username has letters, digits and single hyphens, up to 39 characters.
custom.nameInvalid: A name needs a letter or a number, and cannot hold : or ,
custom.moreHelp: The app generates these from your six colors, for good contrast. You can change any of them.
custom.contrastHelp: The higher the number, the easier to read. Black on white is 21:1.
custom.sides: The sidebar and the background must both be light or both be dark.
custom.darker: Make the background and the sidebar darker.
custom.lighter: Make the background and the sidebar lighter.
custom.saveHint: Save opens when every check passes.

appearance.favoritesHint: Starred themes show in the Design menu, up to three per mode.

journals.titlesDesc: For new entries. Titles you already have stay as they are.
journals.customPatternHelp: Build the title from the tokens below. Text in [square brackets] stays as it is.
journals.customPatternErrorLetter: {{letter}} is not a token. Put words in [square brackets].
journals.customPatternErrorEmpty: This pattern makes an empty title.
journals.customPatternTokens: Tokens, with today as the example:

conflict.title: Sync conflict
conflict.explanation: This note was changed on another device while this device had changes that had not synced yet, and the text differs between the two. We'll keep the version from the other device ({{date}}) unless you choose otherwise.

danger.heading: Danger zone
danger.warning: This is permanent and cannot be undone. Your encryption key lives only in your recovery phrase. Once server data is deleted, there is no way to recover it.
danger.blockedByStorage: You have an active storage subscription. Cancel it from Storage in settings before you can delete your account.
danger.localDesc: Wipes notes, images, and cached data from this device. This does not delete your account, it only cleans up this browser.
danger.localUnsynced_one: {{items}} on this device hasn't synced. Deleting local data destroys it for good.
danger.localUnsynced_other: {{items}} on this device haven't synced. Deleting local data destroys them for good.
danger.cloudDesc: Permanently removes all synced notes, images, devices, settings, and your account from the server. You can sign up again afterward.
danger.noSession: No active session. Try signing in again.
danger.deleteTimeout: Account deletion timed out. Please try again.
danger.activeSubError: You have an active storage subscription. Cancel it from Storage in settings first, then try again.

syncStatus.demoTooltip: Demo mode: changes are not saved and clear when you close this tab
syncStatus.offlineTooltip: You're offline. Changes are saved locally and will sync when you reconnect
syncStatus.syncedVerifyTooltip: A sync pass finished. Click to check this device against the server.
syncStatus.syncedVerifyAria: Synced. Check this device against the server
syncStatus.pendingBlobsBlocked_one: {{count}} file doesn't fit in your storage
syncStatus.pendingBlobsBlocked_other: {{count}} files don't fit in your storage
syncStatus.updateRequiredTooltip: This version of the app is too old to sync safely. Your notes stay on this device until you update.
syncStatus.pausedTooltip: You paused sync on this device. Notes stay here until you resume.
syncStatus.wifiHoldTooltip: Files upload when wifi returns. Notes still sync.
syncStatus.firstSyncPending: This device has not finished its first sync with the server yet, so some notes can still be missing here.
syncStatus.pullFailed: The last sync could not download from the server. It tries again automatically.
syncStatus.notBackedUpTooltip_one: {{count}} note is not backed up. Click to see why.
syncStatus.notBackedUpTooltip_other: {{count}} notes are not backed up. Click to see why.
syncStatus.haltedTooltip_one: Sync stopped with {{count}} note not backed up. Click to see why.
syncStatus.haltedTooltip_other: Sync stopped with {{count}} notes not backed up. Click to see why.
syncStatus.haltedAria_one: Sync stopped, {{count}} note not backed up
syncStatus.haltedAria_other: Sync stopped, {{count}} notes not backed up

errors.noSession: No active session. Try signing in again.
errors.storageUpdateFailed: Could not update storage. Please try again.
errors.reRegisterFailed: This device was revoked but couldn't be re-registered: {{message}}. Reload the page to retry. The row will un-revoke automatically.

syncPanel.passRunning: Syncing your changes with the server...
syncPanel.compareRunning: Comparing every item with the server...
syncPanel.pausedBody: Notes stay on this device until you resume.
syncPanel.rhythm: Edits upload within ~10s as you type. Other devices sync within 30s.
syncPanel.sealed: Encrypted on your device. The server cannot read them.
syncPanel.offlineFact: Works offline. Syncs when you are back online.

calendar.alertsHelp: New items start with these alerts. Each item keeps its own alerts after that.
calendar.reminderTitlesHelp: On, a reminder shows the item's title. Off, it shows only "Reminder" and the time. An item behind your PIN never shows its title.

reminderHint.mobile: Reminders ring on this phone, also while PrivacyNotes is closed.
reminderHint.desktop: Reminders ring while PrivacyNotes runs on this computer.
reminderHint.browser: Reminders ring while PrivacyNotes is open in this browser.

calendar.permissionDenied: Notifications are blocked for PrivacyNotes. Allow them in the settings of this browser or device.
calendar.weekNumbersHelp: In the month view and the small calendars.
calendar.hours: First hour in Day and Week
calendar.checkInReminderHelp: "How are you today?" once a day, on this device. Not on a day you already logged a mood or skipped.
calendar.hoursHelp: The Day and Week views open scrolled to this hour. The hours before it are above.
